terra.problem: Saying nothing in the picture is trying to hide assigns an intention the text does not give.
The final comment is generic and adds little to the explanation.
The text says the pool is draining; it does not say whether its flavor is changing.
The explanation turns the picture of unending treasure into a claim that plunderers keep grabbing it and it never runs out. The passage goes on to say Nineveh is emptied.
The explanation adds that people keep shouting and grabbing and never reach the bottom of the treasure. The passage does not say that and goes on to describe Nineveh as emptied.
Saying the answer describes Nineveh before the plundering adds that she was proud, which the passage does not say.
Saying the lion never comes home short extends the picture beyond what the text says.
Telling a baker who missed the answer that the word is hard to miss can sound dismissive.
